correctness.rationale: The unsigned vertex-edge incidence matrix has full rational row rank for connected nonbipartite G and |E|=|V|+1, leaving a rank-one saturated integer kernel. Its primitive alternating closed-walk generator gives the unique homogeneous prime binomial with disjoint supports and unit/squared exponents; parity yields exact counts s,t,u,v. For a monomial, all partial derivatives vanish iff one squared variable or at least two distinct variables are zero; pairing minimal zero supports across the two disjoint monomials lists all incomparable irreducible coordinate subspaces. Their zero-coordinate cardinalities 2,3,4 give N1,N2,N3 and projective codimensions; at generic points analytic unit absorption gives crossing, surface node and threefold node. Hypersurface S2 plus codim-one criterion R1 yields normal exactly when uv=0 iff ell<=1. Independently reconstructed integer kernels and parity for five graphs; finite checks support, not replace, the general proof. Caution: assertions only over complex ground field and generic points.
residual_risks: Finite exact checks are bounded and are not substituted for the explicitly reconstructed infinite proof or analytic distribution.
